name: modernize-uplift-deltas
description: Same-stack uplift delta catalog: one finder per delta category (intersecting known version breaking-changes with this code), each verified against the cited source
whenToUse: Invoked by /modernize-uplift when the Workflow tool is available. Requires args {system, source, target, projectPattern?}. Returns structured delta cards — the calling session writes DELTA_CATALOG.md and runs the migration (build/dual-run are HITL, not in this workflow).

phases.title: Find
phases.detail: one finder per delta category + ecosystem-tool report

phases.title: Verify
phases.detail: one referee per delta — does this code really hit it?
